text:
claire: kicking off schema migration m-321 (add tenant_pref jsonb + backfill) on prod-shard-6. requesting lease. tagging @marc and @dba for DB watch.

deploybot: Lease granted to migrator-6 for m-321. config: backfill chunk=1200, concurrency=3, throttle=200ms. stall_watch=on. ETA ~22m.

marc: preflight passed but note high write tail expected from billing-job at +10m. if we see >2 long locks over 90s we should hit the holdpoint.

dba: Added pg_stat_activity + blocking_pids monitor. abort_on_sustained_locks=true. Also, index on user_preferences updated last week might lead to lock amplification.

claire: starting now in staggered mode (5% of shards), will monitor for 5m before widening.

deploybot: progress: 0% -> 6% -> 17%. no alerts yet. :rocket:

infra-bot: Watch rule: if blocking_sessions >=2 for 60s -> create holdpoint message in this thread and notify #eng-oncall.

marc: p99 creeping up to 340ms on shard-6. one waiter at 6s on relation user_preferences, resolved. still ok.

claire: ramping to 20% per plan. keep eyes on write tail.

deploybot: traffic_split updated to 20%. progress steady.

marc: spike at 00:10:12 — blocking_sessions=3, longest_lock=14s on user_preferences. This coincides with billing-job burst. holdpoint triggered.

infra-bot: Holdpoint: sustained locks detected. Backfill paused automatically. Manual action required: either gracefully abort+pin or perform controlled eviction of offending worker.

deploybot: Backfill paused, workers signalled. Lease still held for 2m.

claire: I'm seeing one worker still holding a heavy lock and not responding to pause. Options? evict PID or abort? Eviction may leave partial progress.

marc: If eviction frees the lock quickly we can attempt a controlled resume; otherwise abort and pin. prefer abort+pin to avoid partial writes in schema migration.

claire: ok executing abort. abort command: 
```
./deploybot abort --lease migrator-6 --reason "sustained lock during billing burst" --pin v2.19.0
```

deploybot: Abort executed. migration m-321 status=ABORTED. Lease released. Pin applied: platform pinned to v2.19.0 until manual unpin. Incident will be created.

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-0781 created and alerted. Telemetry upload link: https://internal/telemetry/INC-2026-0781

dba: Uploaded `pg_stat_activity` + `pg_locks` snapshots and short trace. Initial notes: billing-job caused heavy temp index churn; recommend coordinating billing-job and migration windows or adding a preflight to detect imminent batch runs.

release-council: Draft release-note: "m-321 migration attempt aborted due to lock contention from concurrent billing batch; services pinned to v2.19.0; retry scheduled in maintenance window Sat 03:00-05:00 UTC with reduced chunk_size=400 and concurrency=1. Unpin after successful canary + 24h observation."

claire: I'll add the abort command, runbook links, and traces to the release notes. Plan: add a preflight check to guard against batch windows and require coordinator signoff next attempt.

marc: also propose adding a short 'eviction then wait' option to runbook for non-critical backfills (not schema-changing ones) to allow faster containment without full abort.

claire: agreed. For schema changes we'll stick to abort+pin conservative approach. Closing thread; follow-ups in the runbook and release notes. :white_check_mark:
